info.description: Self-hosted subscription manager. Every operation is also available to AI agents over MCP at /mcp.

post.description: The built-in assistant reads the document and proposes notice days, cancel link, start date, trial end and account. Nothing is saved: apply what you keep with update_subscription.
post.summary: Read contract details from an attached document
Confirm, discard or undo a change the assistant prepared

get.summary: What the assistant was asked: tokens and estimated cost, newest first

get.description: Charges whose date passed without confirmation, payment methods about to expire, last days to cancel and free trials about to charge.

Facts worth acting on, computed not guessed: duplicates, price increases in the last year, free trials about to charge, last days to cancel, things about to expire, big charges coming, cards about to expire with the subscriptions that depend on them, unconfirmed charges and subscriptions marked as not used.

post.description: Records that a service paid more than once (a group from audit's duplicates, by its key) is on purpose: audit stops reporting it and nobody is messaged about it again.

post.summary: Invite someone to the household (owners only)
Accept an invite and create your account
Choose your own language (empty: the household's)

get.summary: Your linked chat accounts and notification destinations

Get a one-time code to link Slack
Get a one-time code to link Telegram
Send a test reminder to one of your destinations
Unlink a chat account or remove a destination
Finish signing in with a two-factor code
Change your password (signs out your other sessions)
Create an API token for an AI agent or script
Confirm the first code and turn two-factor sign-in on (signs out your other sessions)
Start turning on two-factor sign-in: a new secret for the authenticator app

get.description: For subscriptions with cost shares: what each member paid and should carry in a month, and the fewest payments that settle it.
Every dated event in a period (default: the next year): charges, including the ones the schedule will produce further ahead, free trials ending, things expiring and last days to cancel.

post.summary: Create or replace the calendar link

post.description: Adds a category for grouping subscriptions.
Deletes a category; its subscriptions become uncategorized.
Renames or recolours a category.

get.description: Recent changes with who made them (member, agent or system). Each id can be passed to undo.

post.description: Reverts a change by its auditId, restoring the previous state.

get.description: Charges due between two dates (default: the next 30 days), with ids, amounts, status and whether they were moved.

post.description: Changes the amount of a charge. scope=following (default) also changes the subscription price for later charges; scope=this only this charge.
For subscriptions with a notice period: records that the member wants to keep this renewal, so Exhale stops asking before the last day to cancel. To cancel instead, use set_subscription_status.

Compares the payments of a bank or card statement with the charges Exhale expects (merchant, date within a week, amount within 30%). Changes nothing. Returns the charges each payment confirms: for action mark_paid call set_charge_status with status=paid and the amount paid (dryRun first, then show the user); when priceChange is set, ask whether it is the new price. Also lists open charges due in the period that the statement does not show.
post.summary: Match a statement to expected charges

post.description: Moves a charge to another date. scope=this (default) for a one-off delay; scope=following to change the billing day from this charge on.

Brings a reminder, a keep-or-cancel question or a was-it-charged question about a charge back in a few days at the reminder time. It never comes back too late: a reminder at the latest on the charge date, a keep-or-cancel question on the last day to cancel.
Resolves a charge: paid (optionally with the amount the bank actually took, in any currency), failed, skipped, or pending to reopen it.
post.summary: Mark a charge paid, failed or skipped

get.description: Start here. Returns a live Markdown briefing: today's date and time zone, members, every subscription with ids, the next 30 days of charges, what needs attention, and the rules for changing anything safely.

post.description: Deletes a document attached to a subscription. It is kept 30 days and can be restored with undo.

get.description: Everything the household keeps in Exhale in one JSON document: settings, members, categories, payment methods and every subscription with all its charges.
Household settings, members, categories and payment methods with their ids.

post.description: Changes the display currency (totals convert into it), time zone, reminder language, name, or default reminder time (HH:MM). Owners only. Also how often an unanswered "was it charged?" is asked again (confirmTimes, confirmEveryDays).

Creates many subscriptions in one step, e.g. from a bank statement, a spreadsheet or another app. Categories, payment methods and payers are given by name (missing categories and payment methods are created). Items that duplicate an existing subscription or fail validation are skipped and reported. Always call it first with dryRun and show the user the list.

delete.summary: Forget the import waiting from a chat

get.summary: The import waiting from a chat

get.description: Whether Exhale keeps the computer it runs on from sleeping (so reminders go out and chat buttons answer): off, always, or between two times of day in the household time zone; whether the display may sleep; and the live status (active, waiting outside the hours, unavailable here and why, or the error the system gave).

post.description: Owners only. Keeps the computer Exhale runs on from sleeping: mode off, always, or hours (from and to, HH:MM in the household time zone; to earlier than from crosses midnight). keepDisplayOn keeps the screen on too. A laptop with its lid closed still sleeps. Can be reverted with undo.

post.summary: Make a member an owner or a member (owners only)

get.summary: Members with two-factor sign-in on (owners only)

post.summary: Turn off another member's two-factor sign-in (owners only)

post.description: Creates a payment method (no id) or updates one (with id): name, kind, last four digits, expiry date and owner.
post.summary: Create or update a payment method

post.description: Deletes a payment method. Pass moveTo so its subscriptions move to another method instead of being left without one.
Moves every subscription paid with one method to another in one step, e.g. when a card is about to expire.
post.summary: Move subscriptions to another payment method

get.description: Every reminder Exhale planned, newest first, with what happened to it: sent, scheduled, failed and why, or no longer needed. Answers "why didn't I get that reminder?".

Forget the assistant's settings and key (owners only)
Make one small call to the configured model (owners only)
Allow or block private-network destinations (owners only)
Go back to the public ntfy server (owners only)

post.summary: Set the Slack app tokens or the team channel (owners only)
Set the mail server for email reminders (owners only)
Send a test email to your own address (owners only)

get.description: What was really paid each month (from the charge ledger, not from current prices), what is expected in the coming months, and lifetime paid per subscription.
Lists subscriptions with price, cadence, next charge, monthly cost, category and payment method. Filter by status or name.

post.description: Adds a recurring subscription and computes its upcoming charges. Also covers a free trial (trialEndsOn + the price it becomes), a notice period (noticeDays), things that expire unless renewed (renewal=manual) and subscriptions that already ended (status=cancelled). Use dryRun to preview the charge dates first.

Changes several subscriptions in one step, all or none: set the category or payment method, add or remove tags (action update), or pause, resume, cancel or delete them. Call it first with dryRun to show what changes for each. The auditIds it returns can all be passed to undo to revert the whole change.
Permanently deletes a subscription and its charges. Prefer set_subscription_status to cancel. Can be reverted with undo.
Drops the logo someone uploaded for a subscription: it shows the bundled brand mark or its initials again. Can be reverted with undo.
Pauses, resumes or cancels a subscription. cancel_at_period_end keeps the service until the day before the next charge; cancel_now stops future charges immediately.

Changes name, price (from the next open charge on, or from priceFrom for a change announced in advance), billing cycle or day (interval, unit, nextCharge: from the next charge on), end date, category, payment method, payer, cost shares, privacy, URL, notes, auto-confirm, reminders, or the contract terms (start date, trial end, notice period, renewal, cancel link, account). Only the fields you pass change.

get.description: One subscription with its upcoming charges (with charge ids) and its charge history.
The files attached to a subscription (contract, terms, invoices and receipts), newest first: name, kind, size, the charge an invoice belongs to and the path to download it.

Monthly and yearly recurring spend per currency, spend per category and payment method, how much to set aside each month for yearly bills, what is due before the next payday, the charges of the next 7 days, and what cancelled subscriptions no longer cost per year (stopped).

post.description: Removes a tag from every subscription. The subscriptions stay. Can be reverted with undo (auditIds).
Renames a tag on every subscription that has it; if one already has the new name, they merge. The tags in use are in get_household.
